narration:0:1029717001:0.text: You all arrive at the Uru Settlement, where Alsa welcomes you warmly, along with the other members of the clan...
narration:0:1029717001:0.source_cn: 你们来到了乌尔聚落，阿尔萨带着氏族中的老老小小热情地接...

narration:1:1029717002:0.text: After some rest, Rowan starts to recover his strength...
narration:1:1029717002:0.source_cn: 休整片刻之后，罗万也总算恢复了精神……

say:4:1029717003:0.text: This place... is actually really promising.
say:4:1029717003:0.source_cn: 这里的地理位置，真的相当优越啊！

say:5:1029717004:1.text: Haha, you only say that because the sandstorms scared you and now you're glad to see trees again!
say:5:1029717004:1.source_cn: 哈哈，你是因为被风沙吓到了，看到我们这里有绿洲才会这么说吧。

say:6:1029717005:1.text: Our settlement is actually quite remote, even for the desert.
say:6:1029717005:1.source_cn: 在整个沙漠里，乌尔聚落的位置都算是比较偏僻的呢！

say:7:1029717006:1.text: It's a long trip to Mars Peak, and Alkali's even further. You'd need to ride for ages to get there!
say:7:1029717006:1.source_cn: 离战神峰要走很长时间，离咸水镇就更是遥远了，要坐好久的车！

say:8:1029717007:1.text: No, I'm serious. From a merchant's point of view, this spot is perfect.
say:8:1029717007:1.source_cn: 不不，我是真心的，作为商路的节点，这里的位置真是再合适...

say:9:1029717008:0.text: It's the first stop for merchants entering the Ashen Wastes and the last checkpoint before heading out. It's an ideal trade hub.

choice_prompt:10:1029717008.text: It's the first stop for merchants entering the Ashen Wastes and the last checkpoint before heading out. It's an ideal trade hub.
choice_prompt:10:1029717008.source_cn: 初到荒角沙漠的外来客商第一处歇脚地，而从荒角沙漠向外运输的商队，也可以在这里进行最后一次调整。

say:11:1029717009:0.text: I want to set up a <style="highlight">trade station</style> here as a new base for the Mithril Consortium.

say:15:1029717012:0.text: Yes. Funded by the Mithril Consortium, it would provide a place for caravans to rest, trade goods, and take on purchase and sales orders.
say:15:1029717012:0.source_cn: 对，由秘银商会出资建设，会提供人员车队休整的区域，并且...

say:16:1029717013:0.text: Even if the route reopens, the merchants are scattered. A proper station will help organize larger and more stable trade.
say:16:1029717013:0.source_cn: 毕竟就算开拓商路，这里的行商也相对零散，我们秘银商会的...

say:17:1029717014:1.text: ... But you'd still be in charge?

say:18:1029717015:1.text: Not at all, don't worry. The station would be managed by your local folks, both in terms of visiting caravans and its day-to-day operations.
say:18:1029717015:1.source_cn: 不，放心，这里是交给你们本地负责人来控制的，无论是往来...

say:19:1029717016:1.text: My goal isn't to dominate every transaction. I just want to connect the Ashen Wastes to the broader Consortium network.
say:19:1029717016:1.source_cn: 我的目标并不是要做多少笔具体的订单，而是希望整个荒角沙...

say:20:1029717017:1.text: We've overlooked this region for too long. Most of us sent here, like me, are newcomers. Locals know the land better—they're the ones who'll make this work.
say:20:1029717017:1.source_cn: 而秘银商会对荒角沙漠的经营荒废已久，能派来的也都是我这...

say:21:1029717018:1.text: And with <style="stress"><player_name></style> as our guarantor, we can build mutual trust. That's a big reason I decided to move forward with this idea.
say:21:1029717018:1.male: And with <style="stress"><player_name></style> as our guarantor, we can build mutual trust. That's a big reason I decided to move forward with this idea.

say:26:1029717020:0.text: What's there to hesitate about? This is the kind of chance you can't let slip!
say:26:1029717020:0.source_cn: 还犹豫什么，这样好的机会，可不能错过！

say:27:1029717021:0.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人！您怎么这么快就来了！

say:28:1029717022:0.text: You mentioned <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the Mithril Consortium in your message. Of course I came right away! And don't worry about the lookout post—I've already given orders.

say:29:1029717023:1.text: You introduce Rowan and Brutus, and explain Rowan's plan.
say:29:1029717023:1.source_cn: 你们向布鲁特斯和罗万介绍了彼此，并额外介绍了罗万此次的...

say:30:1029717024:1.text: Hmm. Now that I've heard the whole thing, I'm even more convinced.
say:30:1029717024:1.source_cn: 嗯，在听到详细的计划后，我更坚定了之前的想法。

say:31:1029717025:1.text: This is a great opportunity, Alsa. Don't let it pass your clan by.
say:31:1029717025:1.source_cn: 这是个很好的机会，阿尔萨，你们氏族不要错失。

say:32:1029717026:1.text: I'll make sure you have our full support.
say:32:1029717026:1.source_cn: 我也会带领所有人全力支援你们的，不要再顾虑什么。

say:33:1029717027:1.text: I-I understand! I'll do my best. I won't let you down!
say:33:1029717027:1.source_cn: 我、我明白了！我会尽全力配合，不会让你们失望的！

say:38:1029717031:0.text: I think Alsa can oversee the trade station, and Soren can escort the caravans.
say:38:1029717031:0.source_cn: 在我看来，这位阿尔萨小姐可以在这里主持贸易站，而索恩先...

say:47:1029717037:0.text: I get it. I'll take charge of the station. Soren, make sure the caravans are safe!
say:47:1029717037:0.source_cn: 我明白了，就让我来负责吧！索恩，你也要好好护卫商队！

say:48:1029717038:0.text: And if you find anything interesting, remember to bring something back for the kids!

say:49:1029717039:0.text: Got it. Leave it to me.
